title: An item that adds or changes a backlog.py verb, flag or refusal carries the facade's usage text and the skills that run that command in its touches
goal: Retrospective of SP-qxcj7fgy: three workers added verbs or flags (gate remove, gate host-unchecked, answer --free) or a refusal (new --sprint without --touch) with the usage docstring of _tools/backlog.py and the skills that run the command outside their touches, so they filed BG-5orqmy7i and BG-77i2lwmr for the usage text and the review found ST-j743ue7u and ST-tvnxvfjp for the skills. backlog.py check warns of an item whose goal names a new backlog.py verb or flag, or a new refusal, without _tools/backlog.py and the skills that run that command (backlog.py referrers) in its touches, as plan step 2 asks for every consumer of a changed tool route.

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"ST-testtest","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"draft","priority":"P3","goal":"backlog.py gate retitle ID GATE is a new verb that rewords a gate","touches":["_tools/bl_items.py"],"checks":[{"run":["python3","_tools/backlog.py","check"]}]})); r=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); r("fmt"); p=r("check"); sys.exit(0 if any("ST-testtest" in l and "touches" in l and "_tools/backlog.py" in l for l in (p.stdout+p.stderr).splitlines()) else 1)
